It currently ships:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Thinking chain default-expand** — a floating toggle (the lightbulb button at the bottom-right, o"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"n by default) that automatically expands every "Think" reasoning disclosure in the conversation, so "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"the full thinking chain is visible while streaming instead of a one-line summary.
- **Session cost m"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"eter** — when a session runs on the official DeepSeek API, an estimated session cost (CNY) is shown "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"at the far left of the same line as the built-in input/output token stats, priced per request at the"},{"id":"p5s6","text":" real peak/off-peak hour using the official pricing page rates.
- **GLM Coding Plan quota badge with"},{"id":"p5s7","text":" a fixed-overhead safety line** — when a session runs on GLM (Coding Plan), the same spot shows the "},{"id":"p5s8","text":"subscription quota badge (e.g. `5h额度18%，周额度35%，周窗口40%，安全线52%，5d15h后重置` — quota usage of both windows"},{"id":"p5s9","text":", the weekly window's *time* progress, the fixed-overhead safety line, and the weekly reset countdow"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"n; the badge text is Chinese). Hover for each window's time-to-reset, the safety-line math and more."},{"id":"p5s11","text":" The numbers are account-level truth fetched by the host while GLM streams; zero queries otherwise.
"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"- **Open files in the system app** — clicking a file path in the conversation hands it to your deskt"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"op default application (VS Code, text editor, …) instead of popping the right sidebar. Can be turned"},{"id":"p5s14","text":" off in Settings → General.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2** — required since **0.2.0** (the release that merges in the completion alert)."},{"id":"p7s2","text":" The watcher reads three current Client contracts: the session-list snapshot (`useSessions`: `ids` /"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" `byId.origin`), the per-session UI status (`useSessionStatus`: agent `running` + `pendingInteractio"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"n`) and on-demand job rosters from the `jobs` client service (`watchRows` → `state.rows`). On **dsh "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"≤ 0.1.6** the completion alert simply stays off (the rest of the plugin is unaffected) — those versi"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ons carried job rosters inside the session-list snapshot and dialogs behind `useSessionPendingIntera"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ction`, both removed in 0.1.7.
- **dsh ≥ 0.1.2-alpha.4** — supported since **0.1.5** for everything "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"else. The restructured frontend provides the chat snapshot as the session-standard `useChat` hook an"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"d trajectory as `useTrajectory`; both are adapted, with the legacy paths retained for older dsh. Ver"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"ified against **dsh 0.1.3-alpha.2** since **0.1.9**, against **dsh 0.1.5-rc.2** since **0.1.10** (th"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"e release that adds "Open files in the system app", verified end-to-end on a real desktop), and agai"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"nst **dsh 0.1.7-rc.2** since **0.1.11** — dsh 0.1.7 replaced the per-request `provenance` field with"},{"id":"p7s13","text":" `requestConfig`/`providerMetadata` in the trajectory snapshot, which had silently hidden the cost m"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"eter; **0.1.11** reads all three shapes, so the meter keeps working from 0.1.2-alpha.4 onward. **0.2"},{"id":"p7s15","text":".0** (completion alert) is verified against **dsh 0.1.7-rc.2**. **0.2.1** is verified against **dsh "},{"id":"p7s16","text":"0.2.0-rc.1**. **0.2.2** (GLM quota badge) is verified against **dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2** — its quota chan"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"nel rides on the `llm/stream` waterfall, settings volatile-field relay and `remote.settings.describe"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"`, all official 0.2.x surfaces; **the quota badge needs dsh ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1**, everything else is unaff"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"ected (on older hosts the badge [长行截断]
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- 💡 **Thinking chain default-expand** — the floating lightbulb button in the bottom-right corner (hi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ghlighted when on), sitting above the built-in "scroll to bottom" button:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- When **on** (default), every "Think" reasoning row is expanded automatically — including rows that"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" mount while the agent is still streaming — so you read the full reasoning text without clicking eac"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"h one.
- Toggle it off to restore the built-in collapsed one-line summaries.
- The preference persis"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ts across reloads (localStorage). Manually collapsing an individual row is respected and will not be"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"s (localStorage). Manually collapsing an individual row is respected and will not be force-expanded."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- 💰 **Session cost meter** — on the **same line as the built-in stats line, at its far left**, e.g. "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`≈ ¥0.83 · 2 turns 12 steps | …`:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Only rendered while the session's requests go through the **official DeepSeek API** (provider rout"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"e `deepseek-official`); it disappears once you switch to another API.
- Cost = tokens × official uni"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"t prices (CNY; both models currently on sale are covered — `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`; t"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"he retired names `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` are still callable and are bil"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"led at Flash rates, so they are priced the same), priced per request at its **actual time** with pea"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"k/off-peak rates (peak = Beijing time **Monday–Friday** 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, twice the off-p"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"eak price; weekends are off-peak all day), with cache-hit input at the discounted rate.
- Models **m"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"issing from the price table** (just released upstream, or not yet synced here) are never dropped: th"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ey fall back to the **cheapest price among the known DeepSeek models**, and the hover detail says so"},{"id":"p12s10","text":" ("not in the price table, estimated at the cheapest rate").
- **Accumulate as it happens**: every o"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"bserved request is priced at its real time and persisted immediately (localStorage, per session, las"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"t-wins so nothing double-counts) — history paging pushing old requests out of the browser window doe"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"s not matter. A session that has used this plugin since its creation has an **exact total for its wh"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"ole life**, regardless of how long it gets.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The thinking-chain default-expand works on the official reasoning rows (`[data-variant="think"]` wit"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"h a `[data-disclosure-row][aria-expanded="false"]` row inside). Because the full reasoning text is o"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"nly mounted when a row is open, the plugin clicks each collapsed row to flip the built-in component'"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"s own React state. A `MutationObserver` on `document.body` watches for newly mounted rows (streaming"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" output, new turns) and expands them as they appear; a one-time sweep covers rows that are already r"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"endered. Only *added* subtrees are scanned, so a row you collapse by hand is left alone."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
